meta.title: Services
meta.description: Frontend, Shopify, scraping & bots, performance and accessibility work.

title: SERVICES
intro: One person across the frontend stack — no handoffs, no departments, no lost context between them.

items.name: FRONTEND & WEB APPS
items.desc: Custom web application development — dashboards, internal tools, customer-facing products. Built with React and Next.js, with accessibility considered from the start, not bolted on after.

items.name: SHOPIFY & E-COMMERCE
items.desc: High-performance Shopify 2.0 storefronts — custom sections, subscription flows, product configurators. Built for speed and conversion, not just to look good.

items.name: WEB SCRAPING & BOTS
items.desc: Data extraction pipelines and automation for repetitive manual work — pricing checks, data collection, scheduled reports.

items.name: PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION
items.desc: Core Web Vitals audits and fixes — code splitting, lazy loading, bundle size reduction. The unglamorous work that actually moves the needle on load time.

items.name: ACCESSIBILITY (A11Y)
items.desc: WCAG-checked accessibility audits and remediation — keyboard navigation, screen reader support, contrast fixes. The thing most sites skip.
